s.how: Melt 300g milk chocolate. Stir in 100g marshmallows, 100g jellybeans and 80g peanuts, spread in a lined tin, chill 1 hour and cut into squares.
Peel 4 carrots and cut into sticks. Serve standing up in a glass with 250g hummus on the side for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes and tuck into 8 soft buns. Serve with tomato sauce and mustard. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: the candy factory on Easter Island
w.how: Melt 200g milk chocolate and stir in 80g cornflakes. Spoon into 12 patty cases, press a dip in the middle and fill with mini eggs. Chill until set.

d.how: Juice 6 carrots and 4 oranges, or blitz and strain. Stir together and pour over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
